classifications.likelyCause: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server environment identities (azuresu / azure_pg_admin) differ from local-canonical normalized owners ($db_owner / pg_database_owner). Observer normalizeOwnerName only rewrites datdba→$db_owner and does not equate azuresu or azure_pg_admin↔pg_database_owner. Extension/function ownership and public schema ACL text therefore compare unequal despite equivalent platform defaults.
classifications.semanticSecurityImpact: Low product-security impact: platform extension/schema ownership, not tenant privilege grants. Do not REASSIGN OWNED / ALTER OWNER merely to match role names.
notes: Observer normalization defect candidate: Azure platform roles not treated as environment-equivalent.
